The '''Droecil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Droecil]].
